## About Me

I am a PhD student in the [Department of Mechanical and Mechatronics Engineering](https://uwaterloo.ca/mechanical-mechatronics-engineering/) at the
University of Waterloo, advised by [Prof. Kaan Inal](https://uwaterloo.ca/mechanical-mechatronics-engineering/profile/kinal).
My research is supported by [General Motors Canada](https://www.gm.ca/en/home.html).

My work sits at the intersection of **deep learning** and **computational mechanics**. I trained and study Deep Learning approaches to understand complex material systems and accelerate simulations involving them.

Previously, I completed my BASc. in Mechanical Engineering at the University of Waterloo.

---

## Research Interests

- **Deep Learning Surrogate Models** — Using advanced neural network architectures to replace computationally expensive material models.
- **ML Deployment** — Once a model is built, it needs to run somewhere, either locally, on GPU cluster, or sometimes as part of a more complex simulation system. I develop methods of doing the latter with fewer headaches.
